title.en: Danzaisareta Makegumi Reijou desu ga, Jikan wo Modoseru you ni Natta no de Kondokoso ni Shiawase ni narimasu

altTitles.ja: 断罪された負け組令嬢ですが、時間を戻せるようになったので今度こそ幸せになります

altTitles.en: I Won't Be the Loser Again… With My Power to Turn Back Time, I'll Seize My Own Happiness!
Strength Is the Source of Happiness

description.en:
On what was supposed to be the happiest night of her life, her dreams were utterly shattered—her engagement to the second prince was broken off in public, a humiliating spectacle for all to see.

As a talentless noblewoman, the only thing she ever had was her family’s prestigious name. But with her engagement ruined, she lost everything—her status, her friends, and even her own family, who disowned her. Branded as a “loser” and ridiculed by all, she was exiled to a deserted estate, where she soon found herself trapped in a raging fire, awaiting her inevitable death.

But in her final moments of despair, she made one last wish—if only she had another chance, just once…

And then, a miracle happened. She woke up a full year before her engagement disaster, now blessed with a newfound ability—“Time Reversal”!

This time, she vowed to change her own fate. As she planned her new future, she encountered an unexpected man—the Chief of the Royal Magicians, a mysterious figure feared across the kingdom as “The Savage Sorcerer.”

Despite his terrifying reputation, she soon realized he was gentle, respectful, and the complete opposite of the prince who had abandoned her. The more time she spent with him, the more she found herself drawn to him—until she uncovered the terrible curse he bore, one that caused him to harm anyone he touched… except for her!

But as she uses her power to carve out a brighter future, she finds herself entangled in a conspiracy that threatens the royal family itself!

Will she be able to rewrite her destiny completely? Or will fate lead her down a new and dangerous path?

A romantic and thrilling tale of rebirth and redemption, where a disgraced noblewoman takes fate into her own hands and transforms into the heroine of her own story!
